# Marlon Avery — VP, Applied AI Lead | Founder & CEO, VoicePath | Head of AI, AImpact

> Professional portfolio of Marlon Avery, a Generative AI builder, founder, and educator shipping voice and agentic systems that move real businesses.

## Professional Summary
Marlon Avery is a visionary Chief AI Officer, founder, and educator with 10+ years stewarding frontier AI from lab to market. As VP, Applied AI Lead at JPMorgan Chase, Founder & CEO / Chief AI Officer of VoicePath (Jan 2025 – Present), and Head of AI & CEO of AImpact (May 2023 – Present), Marlon designs and ships voice and agentic systems that automate operations and elevate customer experience across healthcare, finance, insurance, and legal. AImpact has been contracted by Microsoft to lead Azure OpenAI bootcamps and commissioned by Google + Dream Machine Innovation Labs to author the curriculum and headline the AI Library Project five-city tour.

## Key Metrics & Achievements
- VoicePath HIPAA-compliant AI Phone Agent integrated with Veradigm EHR for a Neuroscience Office: 60% improvement in patient communication response times, 50% reduction in administrative workload
- Voice agents cutting customer-service costs up to 40% across healthcare, finance, insurance, and legal
- 50% shorter deployment cycles via reusable HIPAA + SOC-2 voice-AI framework
- Microsoft-contracted Azure OpenAI bootcamps lifting engineer certification pass-rates 30%
- Google + Dream Machine Innovation Labs AI Library Project: five-city GenAI training tour
- AImpact: 80+ workshops, 10,000+ professionals trained, 40% average productivity lift
- AI Grant Writer on GPT-3 (2021) at Lightship Capital: 2.5x grant response throughput, 60% labor reduction
- Lightship Capital interim CTO: led 25+ engineers across 7 portfolio companies
- LiveRamp: ATS Forecasting tool drove 20% client adoption lift; coverage of $55M+ yearly GCP customer cost from 25% to 60%
- Pledge to Equality Scholarship Program: 10,000+ scholarships granted
- Shared stages with leaders from Google, IBM, and Microsoft
- HaHa Davis App reached #1 in the App Store for three weeks
